api:
<BackToBack data={ages} name={|a: &Age| a.band} left={|a: &Age| a.men} right={|a: &Age| a.women} left_label="Men" right_label="Women" />
PropTypeDefault
left, rightFn(&T) -> f64, positive numbersrequired
left_label, right_labeltext"Left", "Right"
left_color, right_colorcoloursthe first and second series colours

Horizontal bars that grow left and right from a shared centre: population pyramids, A/B comparisons. Axis labels show magnitudes on both sides.

examples.title: Population pyramid
examples.description: Men to the left, women to the right, by age band.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn population() {
    let data = use_signal(pyramid());
    rsx! { <BackToBack data={data} name={|a: &Age| a.band} left={|a: &Age| a.men} right={|a: &Age| a.women} left_label="Men (%)" right_label="Women (%)" class="h-80" /> }
}

examples.title: Custom colours
examples.description: The same pyramid in custom colours.
examples.code:

}

examples.title: Referendum
examples.code:
#[component]
fn votes() {
    let data = use_signal(steps(&[
        ("North", 52.),
        ("South", 47.),
        ("East", 61.),
        ("West", 39.),
    ]));
    rsx! { <BackToBack data={data} name={|s: &Step| s.name} left={|s: &Step| s.value} right={|s: &Step| 100. - s.value} left_label="Yes" right_label="No" class="h-56" /> }
}

examples.title: Exports and imports
examples.description: Trade volume per region, exports left and imports right.
examples.code:

examples.title: Cash flow
examples.description: Twelve months of inflow against outflow.
examples.code:

examples.title: Survey agreement
examples.description: Disagree against agree per topic with the legend at the side.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn survey() {
    let data = use_signal(steps(&[
        ("Pricing", 64.),
        ("Support", 82.),
        ("Reliability", 71.),
        ("Onboarding", 55.),
        ("Docs", 48.),
        ("Features", 77.),
    ]));
    rsx! { <BackToBack data={data} name={|s: &Step| s.name} left={|s: &Step| 100. - s.value} right={|s: &Step| s.value} left_label="Disagree" right_label="Agree" left_color={rgb(0xd20f39)} right_color={rgb(0x40a02b)} legend={Legend::list().right()} class="h-72" /> }
}

examples.title: Professional and learning
examples.description: Developers per language split by experience.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn languages_split() {
    let data = use_signal(languages());
    rsx! { <BackToBack data={data} name={|s: &Step| s.name} left={|s: &Step| s.value} right={|s: &Step| s.value * (0.4 + noise(s.value as u64) * 0.8)} left_label="Professional" right_label="Learning" class="h-72" /> }
}
